{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' served the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] as [[Assistant Advisory Undersecretary of Media]]. While watching a promotional screening of ''[[Who Are You To Accuse Me?]]'' in [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Mondder]], the undersecretary was an individual affected by a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Mondder terrorist attack|attack]] by the [[Duroon Rebels]]. The individual's life was saved by a [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]] named [[Uul-Rha-Shan]].
